title: Autonomous Freight Procurement, Carrier Selection & Spot Rate Optimization Engine
description: Enterprise-grade 5-layer autonomous freight procurement system featuring multi-objective carrier scoring, GLEC carbon emissions calculation, spot rate arbitrage, and tiered financial approval governance.

boundaries.name: Integration & Ingestion Layer
boundaries.description: Multi-channel freight intake from ERP, TMS, customer portals, and freight broker spreadsheets.

boundaries.name: n8n Orchestration Layer
boundaries.description: Central event bus managing intake, spot RFQ discovery, approval routing, and carrier tender dispatch.

boundaries.name: Python Decision & Optimization Core
boundaries.description: Analytical intelligence services: geodesic routing, constraint filtering, landed cost, transit distributions, and composite scoring.

boundaries.name: AI & Language Interaction Layer
boundaries.description: Local Ollama Qwen 3B model and Dify workflow copilot for RFQ generation, unstructured quote parsing, and explainability.

boundaries.name: Operational & Governance Layer
boundaries.description: Tiered financial sign-off thresholds, relational SQLite persistence, and immutable audit logging.

components.name: Enterprise ERP & TMS Webhooks
components.description: Transmits raw shipment demands and order milestones via REST webhooks.

components.name: Shipment Intake Normalizer
components.description: Validates payload, resolves geographic hubs, and standardizes Shipment models.

components.name: 01 - Freight Intake Workflow
components.description: Ingests raw requests, triggers normalization, and verifies eligibility.

components.name: 02 - Optimization Workflow
components.description: Executes multi-objective ranking and evaluates capacity confidence.

components.name: 03 - Spot RFQ Broadcast Workflow
components.description: Broadcasts RFQs, extracts carrier quotes, and calculates spot vs contract arbitrage.

components.name: 04 - Approval & Award Workflow
components.description: Enforces tiered governance matrix and dispatches tender awards to winning carriers.

components.name: Geodesic & Lane Enrichment
components.description: Calculates road circuity miles, weather severity, and corridor congestion factors.

components.name: Hard Constraint Filter
components.description: Filters candidates by active compliance, cargo insurance, hazmat endorsement, and reefer specs.

components.name: Landed Cost & Rate Engine
components.description: Computes Base, Fuel, probabilistic Detention, Delay Penalties, and Carbon offsets.

components.name: Transit Distribution Engine
components.description: Predicts P50, P80, P90 transit hours and SLA on-time arrival probability.

components.name: Multi-Objective Optimizer
components.description: Minimizes Total Expected Cost + Risk + Delay + Carbon while maximizing strategic fit.

components.name: Ollama Qwen 3B NLP Engine
components.description: Extracts quote attributes from unstructured text and drafts RFQ packages.

components.name: Dify Reverse Auction Copilot
components.description: Orchestrates game-theoretic reverse auctions, TCO Monte Carlo projections, and BATNA analysis.

components.name: Tiered Financial Governance Gate
components.description: Tier 1 Auto-Award (<= $2,500), Tier 2 Supervisor, Tier 3 Procurement, Tier 4 VP Supply Chain.

components.name: SQLite & Immutable Audit Log
components.description: Stores master carrier scorecards, contracted tariffs, recommendations, and auditable event trails.
